description: Moves one Gmail message out of spam and back to the inbox, as the Not spam button does. Takes the message ID. Returns the message ID, whether it is still in spam, and the labels it carries afterwards.

account.description: Optional email address of the connected account to use (e.g. 'user@gmail.com'). If omitted, the default account is used.

message_id.description: The ID of the message to move out of spam.

name: gws-mcp__gmail_unmark_spam
